meta.title: Kiribee · Hand-poured beeswax candles from Albania
meta.description: Kiribee crafts 100% Albanian beeswax candles in Tirana. Eco-friendly, hypoallergenic, hand-poured by Ana and Aldo with a dash of love.
meta.ogAlt: Kiribee, beeswax candles handmade in Albania

hero.title: Crafted by
hero.lede: Hand-poured candles made of pure Albanian beeswax. Quiet, golden, and a little bit alive.

story.title: Two hands, a quiet workshop, and a dash of love.
story.p1: Ana and Aldo are a couple from Tirana, with backgrounds in finance and the exact sciences, and a passion for the slowest of crafts. During the pandemic, they taught themselves the patient art of working with beeswax, hour by hour, until the wax began to cooperate.
story.p2: They noticed a gap in the Albanian market for genuine beeswax candles and decided to be the first to fill it. Today every Kiribee candle is poured by hand from 100% pure Albanian beeswax. No chemicals, no shortcuts, no compromises.
story.p3: Their mission is small but stubborn. To give people a reason to slow down. To light a candle and let the room soften.

about.title: Meet Ana.
about.lede: She studied finance. She fell for the slowest of crafts. The steady hand behind every Kiribee candle. Aldo is her partner in everything, the second pair of hands that keeps the workshop running.

wraps.title: Beeswax food wraps.
wraps.lede: A reusable, washable, beautifully imperfect alternative to plastic wrap. Cotton soaked in beeswax, tree resin, and jojoba oil. Cut a sheet, warm it with your hands, fold it around your cheese.
